items.name: Soap
items.description:
Source PPZO9410

You can use this thick block of soap to scrub clothes, pots, linens, or anything else that might be dirty. A bar of soap has approximately 50 uses.

items.name: Myceloid Mushroom
items.description: A Myceloid mushroom chunk. Chefs should be aware that the Purple Pox disease can still spread from ingesting this item if it is not prepared with care.

items.name: Tongue of Ghoul
items.description: The tongue of a Ghoul, or ghoul-variant. Handle with care, as this item still carries both its paralytic qualities and ghoul fever until properly cooked.

items.name: Bedroll
items.description: This consists of two woolen sheets sewn together along the bottom and one side to create a bag for sleeping in. Some have cloth straps along the open side so the bedroll can be tied closed while you are sleeping. It can be rolled and tied into a tight coil for storage or transport. Most people use a blanket with the bedroll to stay warm or provide a ground cushion.
